mapper.select: SELECT v.draft_id AS "draftId", v.version_label AS "versionLabel", d.name AS "draftName", d.spec AS "draftSpec", d.client_name AS "clientName", v.stage AS "stage" FROM recipe_versions v JOIN recipe_drafts d ON d.id = v.draft_id WHERE v.id = #{versionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_handoffs WHERE version_id = #{versionId} AND kind = #{kind}

SELECT material_name AS "materialName", ratio_percent AS "ratio", unit_price_per_kg AS "unitPrice", material_code AS "materialCode" FROM recipe_version_bom WHERE version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY COALESCE(ratio_percent, 0) DESC, rank_in_version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotes (product_name, spec, client_code, bom_json, material_cost, loss_rate, loss_cost, markup_rate, markup_cost, labor_cost, packaging_cost, logistics_cost, margin, other_cost1, other_cost2, other_cost3, other_cost4, current_price, total_price, status, source_kind, source_recipe, created_at) VALUES (#{productName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{spec, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, (SELECT c.client_code FROM clients c WHERE c.name = #{clientName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1), #{bomJson}, #{materialCost, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{materialCost, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, 'draft', #{kind}, #{sourceRecipe}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT username FROM employees WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_handoffs (draft_id, version_id, version_label, kind, quote_id, requested_by, requested_by_name, requested_by_username, created_at) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{versionId}, #{versionLabel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{kind}, #{quoteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestedByName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestedByUsername, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now})
INSERT INTO label_requests (handoff_id, ingredients_text, status, updated_at) VALUES (#{handoffId}, #{ingredientsText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'requested', #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_versions SET stage = #{stage} WHERE id = #{versionId} AND (stage IS NULL OR stage = '')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_stage_logs (draft_id, version_id, version_label, stage, employee_id, employee_name, created_at) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{versionId}, #{versionLabel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stage}, #{employeeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{employeeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE recipe_drafts SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{draftId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS "id", s.draft_id AS "draftId", d.name AS "draftName", s.employee_id AS "employeeId", e.name AS "employeeName", e.department AS "employeeDepartment", s.expires_at AS "expiresAt", s.revoked AS "revoked", s.created_at AS "createdAt", s.version_id AS "versionId", v.version_label AS "versionLabel" FROM recipe_shares s LEFT JOIN recipe_drafts d ON d.id = s.draft_id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = s.employee_id LEFT JOIN recipe_versions v ON v.id = s.version_id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
SELECT draft_id FROM recipe_versions WHERE id = #{versionId}
SELECT id FROM recipe_versions WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_shares (draft_id, version_id, employee_id, expires_at, revoked, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{draftId}, #{versionId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{employeeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiresAt}, 0, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now})
